description: Phase B2 candidate for #1468: bind the merged #1471 external-verifier result to an immutable verifier workflow identity, binary digest, execution id, per-run challenge, and short freshness window without claiming independent administration.

inputs.external_verifier_result: absolute external file containing the #1471 result
inputs.provenance_receipt: absolute external file outside the repository

negative_controls: wrong exact #1471 result hash or file digest
reason: Matching a caller-supplied expected issuer/workflow/binary/challenge proves bounded identity agreement only. It does not prove independent administration, verifier binary provenance, receipt signature authenticity, or one-time challenge consumption.
next_gate: independently authenticated provenance receipt plus administrator-controlled issuer/trust-root evidence and a reviewed one-time challenge consumption mechanism
